source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: For a ranged attack against the nearest eligible target, Chaos Terminators get a [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) re-roll. A [Charge roll](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) re-roll is available on declaration. This commits their [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) to ending engaged with the closest eligible target for that charge.
